messages:
Maya: Anyone up for a sunrise paddle + bakery run tomorrow? thinking 6:30am launch, then pastries. Or low-effort dock nap if it's too foggy :kayak: :croissant:
Sam: i'm in for pastries. kayaks make me look athletic for 3 minutes :joy:
Kevin: @Maya where's the meetup spot? can we carpool from the SOMA office?
Maya: meet at 6:15 by the 3rd St bike rack outside the office. i can bring a tiny cooler for coffee. @Olga you still have that folding cart? :coffee:
Olga: yup cart lives in my trunk. i'll bring kombucha instead of coffee? :sparkling_heart:
Jin: would love to but i've got plans early. maybe i'm down for brunch instead — 11am at Taza? also i can dog-sit if anyone needs 🙋‍♂️
Kevin: if the bakery line is long there's a pop-up on 5th that usually has croissants left at 7:15. pro tip: bring a tote, pastries vanish fast.
Maya: nice — rough count: Maya, Sam, Kevin, Olga. @Jin maybe for brunch. i'll DM an eta/update depending on fog. anyone able to swing by office at 6:05 to grab the cart?
Sam: i can swing by. also who wants leftover kombucha on Monday? :raised_hands:
lunch-bot: Reminder: office fridge clean-out scheduled Monday 9am. Please label any personal food/drinks you want to keep.
Olga: labeling it 'Olga's existential fizzy' :laughing:
Maya: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/sunrise-kayak-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA (very mood)
Sam: okay see y'all at 6:15, or brunch if fog wins.
